ticket.title: verify stamps a receipt with the invoking repo's branch and commit count, even when the ticket has nothing to do with it

task.title: verify stamps a receipt with the invoking repo's branch and commit count, even when the ticket has nothing to do with it

events.description: TWO MORE MEASURED INSTANCES 2026-11-10, both while closing delivered tickets, and both are the same shape from opposite directions. (1) BW-33 was fixed in common (20213d6) but filed in benchwork store, so storypole verify BW-33 ran the benchwork chain: the receipt now attests that benchwork builds, lints and tests, and says nothing about the emission guard the ticket is about. (2) GB-347 spans twelve stores, and its verify receipt says repo storypole, chain storypole, because its crate scope storypole-core resolves to that repository (SP-50) - so the ticket wide evidence had to be recorded in prose beside the receipt rather than inside it. Nothing here is false: each receipt names the repository and chain that ran. The defect is that a reader who takes receipt exit 0 as proof of the ticket claim over-reads it, and the fix is for a receipt to say what it did not cover - the chain it ran versus the repositories the ticket touches. That is a superset of this ticket original scope, which was only about a receipt borrowing the invoking repository branch and commit count.
